quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Metal soft-magnetic powder cores in 2025 (annual report): revenue grew steadily; telecom, server power supply and UPS applications grew at high speed as global cloud vendors kept raising AI data-center capex; new-energy vehicle and charging-pile sales grew fast with recognition from brands such as BYD and Huawei and a series of major overseas customer wins; energy-storage revenue grew at high speed; air-conditioner revenue fell because the company's capacity was tight overall during the period and it chose to give up part of the low-price market.

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Inductor components in 2025 (annual report): revenue grew fast; H1 inductor revenue was slightly down YoY, but in H2 a series of new technologies, projects and customers plus new capacity restored high growth. The chip inductors achieved mass-production breakthroughs in ASIC and optical-module applications during the year; the company notes the market widely expects ASIC to reach an important turning point in 2026 as Google, Amazon, Meta and Microsoft accelerate large-scale deployment of in-house ASICs, which it calls a large market opportunity for its chip inductors. Core-product yields rose substantially and delivery lead times shortened. Capacity: accelerating the new high-end integrated molded inductor project at the Huidong base, aiming to put it into use as soon as possible in 2026, and adding equipment and automation on existing lines to prepare for continued GPU market growth and volume production in other applications.
quarterly_data.figure: mass production in ASIC and optical modules; Huidong inductor project targeted for use in 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Metal soft-magnetic powder in 2025 (annual report): revenue grew steadily and fast on new-energy vehicle and AI server demand; the new powder plant is being built in phases, and several amorphous/nanocrystalline and water-atomized FeSiCr powder lines were completed and put into production during the year; the company expects the base, once fully built, to ease the current capacity bottleneck. Its self-developed FeSiCr powder (Bs of at least 1.5T) has passed certification at leading customers, replaced imports and is accelerating batch delivery; its amorphous nanocrystalline powder has entered mass-production introduction and is ramping quickly.
quarterly_data.figure: FeSiCr powder passed leading-customer certification; nanocrystalline powder ramping

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): the company plans to grow its integrated molded inductors further - deepening AI server GPU chip power supply and broadening customers, while pushing market promotion, sampling / certification and volume delivery of chip inductors for AI phones, AI PCs and smart driving, and of integrated molded inductors for DDR and optical modules; to cultivate axial-flux motor cores for drones and robots and develop magnetic-fluid seals for the pan-semiconductor field; and to accelerate production-line construction, team building and business development at its Thailand subsidiary and Hong Kong joint venture. The board's letter says the effects of the business-mix shift toward chip inductors will show further in 2026.
